summary: Validated (validate --run <run> --submission update41.json → valid=true). Closing record for open-run continuity, written as a single paused investigation rather than a declaration of completion. This run's experiment allocation was already exhausted when my work began, so every finding I produced is source-established with explicit conditions and no executed witness. Instead of leaving that implicit, the record consolidates the five unwitnessed findings with the smallest execution that would settle each: (1) verification evidence — a cluster with few voters plus at least two non-voters, leader isolated from all voters while non-voters stay connected, observing a successful verification with zero voter acknowledgements; (2) the explicit non-voter transfer — three voters plus one non-voting member, the explicit entry point, observing the incumbent lose leadership, the target never win, and the future report success; (3) the transfer readiness cursor — a leader elected while one voter is unreachable, then the explicit transfer for that voter immediately on its return, observing TimeoutNow sent before any successful replication response; (4) the lease validation gap — a three-node cluster with a one-second heartbeat timeout and a five-millisecond lease, observing repeated leadership loss; (5) the snapshot-install cycle — a leader compacted above a divergence point and a follower whose cached last index exceeds the snapshot index, observing repeated snapshot transfers with the match index pinned. Resume conditions state what each successor needs, including that item 5 may require a purpose-built prefix and that the previously paused pre-vote fallback question cannot be settled by any execution in this snapshot. Limitations say plainly that the record adds no source evidence, that the ordering is by self-containment rather than severity, and that any of the items could be refuted by execution — which is why they are listed. The run ends here by budget expiry; no stop declaration is made, and no empty closing action was taken.
